articles.summary: Long-delayed work to replace watermains along University Avenue began Monday, kicking off extended lane restrictions along a portion of the busy street until next spring. articles.title: 2 dead after Scarborough shooting: police
articles.summary: Two people are dead following a shooting near Warden Avenue and St. Clair Avenue E. Monday afternoon, Toronto police say.

articles.title: Peel Regional Police Association endorses Alvin Tedjo in Mississauga mayoral race
articles.summary: The association is endorsing a candidate in Mississauga’s municipal campaign for what the organization says is the first time in its history. The Peel police union's president said Monday that Tedjo "understands that public safety is not just a slogan, it's a responsibility."

articles.summary: Two people have been killed in a shooting in Scarborough Monday afternoon. Toronto police were called to Warden and St. Clair Avenue East just after 12:30 p.m. The victims were found with gunshot wounds and pronounced dead on the scene. articles.title: Peel police union backs Alvin Tedjo in first ever endorsement of Mississauga mayoral candidate
articles.summary: In their first endorsement of a mayoral candidate ever, the Peel Regional Police Association (PRPA) has endorsed Alvin Tedjo to become the next mayor of Mississauga. articles.title: Ontario launches project to refurbish 4 nuclear reactors at Pickering plant
articles.summary: An Ontario nuclear plant is beginning a massive refurbishment project today, as Premier Doug Ford's government looks to lean heavily on nuclear energy to serve the province's growing electricity needs.

articles.title: CNN, MS NOW, Politico sue over denied White House access, citing First Amendment
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — CNN, MS NOW and Politico on Monday sued President Donald Trump’s administration days after they were barred from covering the White House, calling the selective ban an illegal action and “a blatant violation” of the First Amendment.

articles.title: This Toronto director turned his hometown into a film. Now, it’s premiering at TIFF
articles.summary: What happens when a filmmaker makes a movie about the neighbourhood where he grew up? Sunburn, set on one of the hottest days of the year in Toronto's St. James Town, makes its world premiere tonight at TIFF. CBC's Haydn Watters travelled to Bleecker Street to chat with the director and cast.

articles.title: Toronto peace groups host downtown march against gun violence
articles.summary: Two Toronto peace organizations held a community march against gun violence in the city’s downtown core Saturday, following the fatal shooting of a 17-year-old earlier this week.

articles.title: Candidates in Toronto's east end are arguing over a Gardiner ramp that doesn't exist anymore
articles.summary: A years-gone ramp on the Gardiner Expressway is haunting the race for city councillor in Toronto’s east end, with some candidates saying another’s promise to resurrect it is just smoke and mirrors.
